description: This file defines a Java class AcceptClientTransferCommandHandler that handles accepting client transfer commands within the Fineract financial platform. It implements command processing logic, interacts with the transfer service, and is annotated for dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: AcceptClientTransferCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles accepting client transfer commands, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, and utilizing transfer service to process the command.

methods.name: AcceptClientTransferCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the TransferWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to accept a client transfer by delegating to the transfer service.
